# Amiya's Desk

> Amiya's Desk is the personal site of independent software developer Amiya_desi, covering web software, Godot games, open-source tools, writing, and contact details.

## Context

- Site: https://sayori.org/
- Owner: Amiya_desi
- Public contact: me@sayori.org
- Languages: Chinese and English
- Public business name: Amiya_desi
- Purpose: independent software development, public writing, project records, creator tools, and durable links.

Amiya_desi develops and maintains web software services, developer tools, open-source software, and Godot games. GeoScore is the main SaaS project currently online. It is free to use at present, and sayori.org does not currently offer a paid subscription or on-site checkout. Prices, delivery, refund, and cancellation terms will be published before any paid plan or software sale launches.

- Service status: https://status.sayori.org/

The GeoScore audit API is public under its documented limits and accepts public hostnames only. The hosted Search Gateway instance remains private infrastructure and is not a public API. Paused experiments, private storage, and internal management endpoints are not public services.

## Crawl Policy

Search indexing, real-time AI grounding, AI citation, and model training uses are allowed for public content. The canonical sitemap is linked above, and llms.txt is advertised from the site's HTML head.
